coaching.headline: Down eight structures to one, the team won a 4-0 stretch, then took every Orb Prime, Primal Fangtooth and Shaper left in the game.

flags.text: After the 4-0 stretch, Sparrow and Feng Mao split two Orb Primes and two Primal Fangtooths.
Scarlett hit a damn 910 hero damage per minute, own average 577, and razed the enemy mid inner.
Khaimera died 11 times, the game's most: 5 to Bayle and 4 outside any detected fight.
Fangtooth was followed by a shit 1-4 fight, then the allied mid inner and duo outer fell.

focus.title: Walk out of the pit together
focus.action: After every Fangtooth or Primal Fangtooth take, the team leaves the pit as a group toward the nearest enemy tower, and Khaimera crosses to the duo lane only once Bayle and Eden show elsewhere.

17.call: Two separate plays: Feng Mao killed Zinx and Eden on the duo lane, Sparrow killed Bayle on mid, and Greystone took the allied offlane inner. Feng Mao then took Fangtooth, the first allied Fangtooth of the game.

18.4.call: Lost 1-4 after the Fangtooth take: Greystone killed Feng Mao, Eden killed Khaimera at the pit, and The Fey killed Sparrow and Steel.

27.7.call: Four kills, no allied death: Feng Mao on Eden, Sparrow on Bayle, Khaimera on Zinx, Steel on The Fey; Sparrow then took Orb Prime. Picks first, nearest prize second.

Took Fangtooth and the first allied Primal Fangtooth, then died soon after both takes, to Greystone and Eden. After a pit take, let Steel lead out before chasing kills.

build: Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds match two of the 56.8% core; Lightning Hawk never made the build.

eternal: Demiurge boosts item stats and item-effect damage; Cursed Corrupted converts crit chance from Tainted Rounds and Vanquisher into ability haste.
Lotus and Weald lead a toss-up in this carry field; Demiurge ranks fifth among Eternals with enough games.
Tri-Core with Bloatware is the best Demiurge pair; the Cursed Corrupted run is a close second.
augment: Sun Shards makes basic attacks ricochet for extra damage, applying on-hit effects at reduced effectiveness.
Sun Shards and Endless Hunt are a toss-up in this carry field, Sun Shards the most played. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's active grants attack speed and omnivamp and empowers basic attacks briefly.
Pacifier is clearly the best crest in this carry field; Eviscerator ranks third among crests with enough games.

improvement: Physical armor was the unmet need against Eden's three kills; slot an armor item before Spectra when Eden gets ahead.
Pacifier over Eviscerator is the field-backed crest swap: a dash and empowered physical hit instead of the attack-speed burst.
Lightning Hawk would complete the 56.8% core, trading Storm Breaker's chain lightning for a slowing empowered hit.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash in, Hamstring twice to slow, Safeguard to block the key ability, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on a kill
ourKits.winCondition: trade with Safeguard up and chain Earth Shatter executes and Reaping Dash cooldown resets in fights
ourKits.passive: unique hero takedowns permanently grant bonus physical penetration, and all his physical penetration is increased
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's Spellshield before committing your key CC; back off when low, since Earth Shatter executes and recasts on a kill; armor counters his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
enemyKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
enemyKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

enemyKits.combo: poke with Sidewind's Railshot and Tachyon Lance at range, swap with Zero Shift, dash in with Talon Drive and Axiom Strike, then Limit Break once Overheated
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat by damaging heroes and unload Limit Break, flexing between range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Heat; at max Heat she Overheats and unlocks Limit Break, and Heat decays if she stops hitting heroes
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her keep damaging heroes to build Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: disengage to let her Heat decay before she Overheats; punish melee stance after Talon Drive is spent, and buy anti-heal against her melee stance healing; armor blunts her physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
enemyKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
enemyKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

bullets: Vermis made quick repeated basic attacks on one hero deal a max-health hit; Serration added missing-health damage to Vermis; Melting Point hit targets above an armor threshold harder.
Dust Devil stacked attack speed while basic attacking heroes, and Helios Core turns attack speed into physical power, so steady attacks on heroes raised both speed and damage.
Basilisk shredded armor on hero hits and Demolisher ignored part of the rest, so Tachyon Lance and basic attacks hit tanks harder; Imperator boosted critical strike damage.
Satariel's Fearless stacks from takedowns raised power and attack speed but cut max health and were lost on death; Risen added omnivamp at 3 or more stacks.
Psychosis raised damage on the closest hero but cut damage on others, suiting Kingslayer's dash onto one hero; Manta Scythe added damage on targets with no ally nearby.
After each cast, Syonic Echo sped up the next few basic attacks and reset the swing, while Tainted Trident cut the target's healing on any physical damage.
Thraex marked Greystone's basic attack target for more damage to and less damage from that hero; Savage Strikes added self-healing on-hit damage; Ferocity stacked attack speed in fights.
Ability casts, including Sacred Oath, let Augmentation empower the next basic attack on a short cooldown; Ferocity's attack speed meant more Tainted Rounds and Sky Splitter hits.
Stone Forged Soul's heal, Aegis Of Agawar's extra armor at low health and Salvation's shield below a health threshold, on a cooldown, kept Greystone in fights.
Demiurge raised item stats and item-effect damage like Storm Breaker's lightning; Tri-Core added on-hit damage of a random type; Cursed Corrupted traded critical chance for ability haste.
After Heightened Senses, bonus attack speed fed more basic attacks into Sky Splitter and Tainted Rounds; Viper added on-hit and ability damage against Eroded heroes.
Storm Breaker built Momentum from moving and basic attacks, then an empowered hit chained lightning to several targets, and Inner Fire's arrows applied on-hit effects at reduced strength.

Primal Fangtooth cost 3 allied deaths within a minute: Sparrow, Feng Mao and Khaimera.
